recentItems.title: Israel’s Mossad Chief In US For ‘Iran War’ Meeting With CIA Boss? Netanyahu Keeps Eisenkot In Dark?
recentItems.description:

A shocking report by Axios has raised alarms amongst the power centres of the middle east. It claims that the Mossad Director Roman Gofman was in Washington recently for a meeting with his CIA counterpart John Ratcliffe. The meeting was reportedly held to discuss Iran’s war with the United States.
The report also hinted at an expected meeting between Steve Witkoff and Gofman in Miami. Axios said that Mossad, the CIA, and White House declined to comment.
